title: Volume 1 Chapter 1: Kyouka Uzen's Arc 2
content: "I'm sure you were envious, right? If it's just this much, as your master, I'll do it for you. Now, say 'ahh.'"
"But I'm not in a position to receive a reward right now."
"Oh? You don't want it?"
"I do, I'll gladly accept it!"
"That's right. In times like this, it's best to accept it honestly."
The peach that Kyouka fed him with 'ahh' felt incredibly sweet to Yuki.
"It looks delicious. You can have another bite. Should I say it again?"
"Ahh."
"Heh. Such a spoiled one, here you go."
"Thank you very much."
"You said you wanted to be popular, but haven't you been popular since joining the Anti-Demon Corps?"
Well, when I'm surrounded by women, I get overwhelmed and go silent.
The Anti-Demon Corps is tough work, and I can't afford to be distracted.
"Hmm, good. Now it's your turn to ask a question."
"Kyouka-san, was there something you wanted to try during your student days?"
"Oh? Are you going to grant my wish in return for feeding me?"
"If it's something that can be granted."
"My wish since my student days has been the extermination of Shuki. That's all there is to it."
A fiery determination shone in Kyouka's eyes.
"So, you just need to keep working hard. That will lead to my wish being fulfilled."
"Yes, let's make that wish come true."
"Do you have any photos of Kyouka-san from your student days?"
"What do you plan to do with that?"
"Well, I'm just curious."
I didn't take any photos.
It was nothing but days of training.
I kept my distance from others.
No, it was probably because I didn't let anyone get close until high school.
"Was it different in high school?"
The high school I entered on recommendation was Magic Defense University Affiliated.
Many people there aspired to join the Anti-Demon Corps.
It was filled with comrades aiming for the same goal.
"Kyouka-san, you skipped grades there, right?"
That's right.
Depending on your grades, you could skip ahead rapidly.
I wanted to get to the field quickly.
Yachiho, who is Himari's older sister, was a junior but skipped grades like crazy.
"As expected of the Azuma family, impressive."
As he said that, Yuki poured tea into Kyouka's empty teacup.
"You’re impressive too. You notice things well."
"That's my sister's teaching."
Yuki said proudly.
"My question now. What kind of person do you like?"
He almost reflexively said someone like his sister but stopped himself.
The thorough education from his sister that shaped Yuki was truly formidable.
"I'm sorry, Yuki Wakura, I'll do my best with sit-ups."
"Hmm? Was that such a difficult question?"
"Surprisingly."
After finishing his sit-ups, Yuki asked Kyouka a question.
"Kyouka-san, what kind of person do you like?"
"I like someone with guts."
"Guts, huh?"
"You look troubled wondering if you have any. You definitely have guts."
"So, you like me?"
"That's right, I like you."
This liking was probably not in a romantic sense but as a person, and Yuki felt happy.
"Yuki, what's your favorite word?"
"Organizing and tidying up."
"Yeah, that's important."
"I'm sorry for such an unoriginal word."
"I'm not looking for a comedy routine; I want to know about you, so it doesn't need to be surprising."
"What dream did you have recently?"
A dream?
I often dream about working, actually.
But recently, I had a dream where I went to eat churrasco with the squad leaders.
After that, we had a sumo tournament.
"That sounds quite playful."
"Isn't it healthy? In reality, we occasionally go out to eat together. Now then..."
Kyouka looked at the clock.
"It's my turn to ask a question, but it seems more time has passed than I thought."
It was already nine o'clock at night.
"Let's end the Q&A here."
"When did it become this time? Time flies when you're having fun."
"Shall we start preparing for bed? Tomorrow we wake up at five, rain or shine, training will commence."
Kyouka efficiently gave instructions for bedtime.
Seeing Kyouka's back, Yuki moved briskly as well.
While brushing her teeth, Kyouka moved her waist.
"Is that also training?"
"Just a bit for my legs and waist. You don’t need to imitate me; focus on brushing your teeth properly."
"Always training whenever there's a chance, huh?"
"While I do want to become stronger, I genuinely enjoy moving my body."
They slept in adjacent rooms.
(Damn, this is bad, I can't sleep.)
Usually, Yuki could fall asleep as soon as he was tired, but now, the different pillow and the sense of mission to wake up early kept him awake.
While drinking water in the kitchen, Kyouka came out.
"I sensed your presence. Can't sleep?"
"Yes, the more I try to sleep, the less I can."
"Go to bed. I'll help you fall asleep."
"Huh?"
"Come on, come on, sleep is important."
Kyouka pushed Yuki's body gently.
He lay down on the bed.
"Are you going to press some acupressure points on me?"
"That might help, but it's just before bed. Let's try to do it in a way that minimizes stimulation to your body."
Kyouka lit some aroma she brought from her room.
It smelled like cypress, a calming scent filled the room.
"This is relaxing."
This aroma was taught to me by my mentor, Riu Meika.
There was a time when I had trouble sleeping due to my anger towards Shuki, and she prepared this for me.
As she said that, Kyouka lightly stroked Yuki's back.
"There was a time when I lived together with my mentor."
"Is that so?"
"Until I graduated from elementary school. When I couldn't sleep, she would do this for me."
"She must have been a kind mentor."
"She was strict most of the time. But when I couldn't sleep, she would silently do this for me."
Listening to Kyouka's gentle voice, Yuki began to feel sleepy.
"I'll stay here until you fall asleep."
Hearing those soothing words, his consciousness began to drift away.
Eventually, Yuki fell into a deep sleep.
"It seems to have worked. Good night, Yuki. See you tomorrow."
Once she confirmed that her slave had fallen asleep, Kyouka returned to her room and slipped into bed.
(Counting. Himari, Shushu, Nei...)
Like counting sheep, Kyouka mentally recited the roll call for the 7th Squad.
It was a sleep routine she devised to ensure she could rest well when she had the chance.
Kyouka quickly fell into a deep sleep.
The second day at the resort was beautifully sunny.
"Did you sleep well after that?"
"Yes, perfectly."
"Good. Today is the main training day. If you're lacking in stamina, it won't matter."
After eating the breakfast Yuki made, they prepared for training and headed outside.
"Today's training is a spar with me."
"You mean, I'm going to fight Kyouka-san?"
"Let’s call it a match instead of a spar. We want to avoid any complacency."
"Understood. Kyouka-san, I'll borrow your chest."
"Come at me with all your strength."
Yuki had already completed his transformation, and after both of them distanced themselves sufficiently, they faced each other.
"I'll let you take the first move."
The pressure from Kyouka, who had her sword drawn, reached Yuki.
There was absolutely no opening.
"Are you not coming, Yuki?"
He could see a vision of himself being defeated no matter which angle he attacked from.
"Then I'll make the first move."
Kyouka stepped forward slowly.
Yuki kicked the ground hard, trying to throw a clump of dirt at Kyouka.
Kyouka avoided the dirt with minimal movement.
Yuki took advantage of that opening to circle around and throw a punch at Kyouka.
However, before he could land it, Kyouka's sword struck him hard.
"Ugh!"
Even though it was a blunt strike, the impact was considerable.
"Attacking after creating a smoke screen isn't bad, but your movements were too slow."
Yuki thought he was attacking with lightning speed, but Kyouka responded calmly.
Avoiding Kyouka's follow-up strike, Yuki took a large step back.
But in that instant, a sword was thrust toward him.
As Yuki retreated, Kyouka threw her sword at him.
Yuki barely managed to catch the thrown sword with his hand.
"Good reflexes. Even if you think you've created distance, never let your guard down for even a moment."
Kyouka was a martial artist capable of defeating Shuki with her bare hands without needing a sword.
If he attacked carelessly, he would be beaten down by her martial arts.
"I'll make use of this sword!"
Yuki threw the sword at Kyouka.
The sword spun as it flew toward her.
Yuki dashed after it.
Kyouka rotated her body to wrap around the incoming spinning sword.
Then, using that momentum, she deflected the sword back toward Yuki.
"What!?"
Yuki barely managed to catch the suddenly returning blade.
In that moment, Kyouka's fist sank into Yuki's abdomen.
Yuki collapsed.
Immediately, Kyouka's leg wrapped around his neck.
"If you stay down like that, this will happen."
Yuki thought he was about to be choked out.
"Damn, I couldn't stand a chance at all."
Yuki had challenged Kyouka over and over again since then, but he had been defeated every time.
But if I didn't unleash a variety of techniques, it would have been difficult to respond.
You're getting stronger, Yuki.
"But I still couldn't win in the end."
Don't think you can win against the squad leader so easily.
You passed.
You're getting stronger.
It was the right choice to come here.
"Well, I'm glad to hear that."
"By sparring, I was able to understand your movements even better."
"Yes, I feel the same."
"You must be tired. Change back to your human form."
Yuki returned to his human shape.
The gazes of Kyouka and Yuki intertwined.
They both understood that the time for rewards was about to begin.
"Hmm... This reward... I didn't expect it to come like this, you pervert."
"Huh?"
Kyouka took Yuki's hand and guided it to her chest, gently resting it there.
"Kyouka-san!?"
"I can't believe the line about borrowing my chest was foreshadowing this. I'm amazed."
As she said that, Kyouka froze.
During the reward, Kyouka's movements were involuntary.
(So, this time the reward is her chest...)
If Yuki didn't accept the reward, it wouldn't end.
He needed to actively move his hand that was resting on her chest.
"I-I'll take my leave now."
"Ah... Move freely."
Even with a flushed face, Kyouka spoke while firmly looking into Yuki's eyes.
Yuki stroked Kyouka's chest over her Magic Defense Corps uniform.
At that moment, Kyouka's body shivered slightly.
"I-I just felt a little ticklish, so don't worry about it."
The rich sensation transmitted through his hand.
Yuki began to move, shaking the fullness.
"I feel like my hands were trembling when I touched before, but now I'm quite used to it."
"If it hurts, please tell me."
"Far from hurting, it seems this isn't going to end here."
"Huh?"
"Touch directly."
Kyouka undid the buttons of her uniform as she spoke.
Yuki instinctively looked away.
"Don't look away. Accept the reward."
"Y-Yes."
"You can't be satisfied unless you touch directly. Really, you pervert."
Kyouka's chest was now exposed.
Yuki gulped.
"Stop dawdling and come here. Are you planning to just stare at me?"
"It sounds like you're the most fired up since I got here..."
Yuki's hands enveloped the white chest, shaking and stimulating it.
Kyouka's chest was firm yet soft and moist.
As Yuki kneaded her, Kyouka let out a slightly sweet voice.
Given Kyouka's well-trained body, it returned a fresh elasticity when touched.
"Are my hands moving on their own...?"
Kyouka firmly grasped Yuki's head and guided his mouth to her chest.
"This is..."
"It means you should use your mouth as well..."
Yuki took Kyouka's nipple into his mouth and began to suck on it.
"Ugh... Did you want to be spoiled by me?"
After finishing one side, he moved to the other.
"Kyouka-san, are you okay?"
"Ah, keep going."
Her sweaty breasts swayed enticingly.
Yuki leaned in closer again.
